title: Seed replay: a dataset of a global object (tenancy disabled) throws INVALID_FILTER on a per-organization replay
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cw787kMeaX7oyz7DDC

Found while fixing #33411 (PR #33550). Measured, not inferred: a temporary case in that PR's integration harness (real AppPlugin + SeedLoaderService + ObjectQL + SqlDriver over better-sqlite3), since removed.

## Line

AppPlugin's per-organization seed replayer (the replay that runs on a `sys_organization` insert) · a seed dataset of an object declared `tenancy: { enabled: false }` (a global catalog) · every walled boot that ships such a dataset · measured.

`replayer(ORG_NORTH)` on `{ object: 'crm_country', mode: 'upsert', externalId: 'name', records: [{ name: 'Japan' }] }`, where `crm_country` declares `tenancy: { enabled: false }`, throws the driver's INVALID_FILTER ("A filter on object crm_country names a column the database could not resolve"), and the row does not land.

Cause: `SeedLoaderService.loadExistingRecords` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`) filters existing rows by organization on every per-organization replay. A global object resolves no tenant column, so the filter falls back to `organization_id`, which the object does not have. This is the same before and after #33550, which only made the column follow a declared `tenancy.tenantField`.

## Do

- On a per-organization replay, match a global object's existing rows unscoped. Key the decision on the same predicate `probeScopeOf` already uses for `'global'` (the #33409 reference-probe precedent), so there is one reading and no second list. Every new organization's replay then upserts the one shared row instead of throwing.
- The alternative is to refuse such a dataset by name. It is not recommended: a global catalog seeded with an app is a normal shape, and the unscoped match is what the reference probe already does.
- Pin with a real AppPlugin + SqlDriver integration case: two organizations replay a global dataset, exactly one shared row exists after both, and a second replay is idempotent. Keep the #33411 tenantField case and an ordinary `organization_id` control green. Ablate.

Reader who acts: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`.
Suggested grade: p2 (a seed dataset that cannot land; no wrong data written). Lane: `domain:server`. Serial after #33550 (same function).
